meaning: A narrowly targeted data-engineering and training proposal is justified; this is not authorization to train, use GPU, promote a model, or change production defaults.
review_provenance: Muneeb Anjum self-attested independent human review; process not observed; decision vector identical to prior GPT-5.6 Sol advisory review.
contamination: No exact/simple near-overlap detected against supplied V5 train/validation/test; no exact normalized pair overlap with available closed historical finals. Archive-to-adapter exact byte identity and inaccessible sources remain unknown.

recurring_clear_boundary.pattern: Explicit baseline option/channel/data-item removal classified modified
recurring_clear_boundary.frozen_p1_rule: removed = any explicit baseline capability, option, permission, or scope item is eliminated, even if other options remain

other_errors.unchanged_boundary_caution: All seven are same-domain but unrelated new-feature messages. P1's added definition can also be read to cover a new capability while the baseline remains; these are label-sensitive diagnostics. Frozen primary labels and score are not changed after predictions. Do not train on them without separate independent adjudication.

bounded_stability: 12/12 repeat labels matched first pass; two selected errors remained errors. This does not establish stability for all 17 errors.
data_engineering_path: Deduplicate and group by project/source/template family; create genuinely independent human-reviewed removal-vs-modification examples across domains; retain the Phase III-I corpus as a permanent closed final; establish fresh independent final and rollback before any training.
decision_basis: The seven explicit-removal misses remain a recurring model-semantic pattern even if the seven label-sensitive unchanged hard negatives are set aside analytically. Direct oracle delivery, 90/90 structure, and zero PP1 changes separate this from retrieval/parser/postprocessing failure. A repaired training corpus is feasible but not yet ready.
limitations: Human review is self-attested rather than externally audited and all decisions equal the earlier model advisory vector.
The corpus is synthetic, balanced, and only 15 cases per class; it is diagnostic, not production prevalence.
Prompt wording versus model-weight contribution cannot be fully isolated without a separately authorized experiment.
Original adapter training file identity is probable but unproven by checkpoint hash; historical legacy rows are not fully recovered.
